subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half shipped?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but linked candidate branches are stale, conflicting, closed, or broader than this issue, so automation should not create another competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace with focused fix
options.body: Open or sponsor a current-main repair for non-direct Mattermost route persistence with live cron/heartbeat proof and targeted session tests.

options.title: Adopt an existing candidate
options.body: Choose a linked candidate PR, refresh it onto current main, and require it to preserve current session-key and route-metadata contracts before merge.

options.title: Close remaining scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is no longer supported.

recommendation.title: Replace with focused fix
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a current-main repair for non-direct Mattermost route persistence with live cron/heartbeat proof and targeted session tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and verified the shipped message-tool replacement and have recent adjacent history in the outbound route-threading path that the remaining fix must preserve.
